tradingEnabled.label: Enable trading
tradingEnabled.description: Trading runs only while this is on. Only a person can change it — the model has no way to.

activeUntil.label: End date
activeUntil.description: Inclusive of this day. Empty runs indefinitely. An unreadable date halts trading rather than removing the deadline.

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: dryrun = ledger only, no orders · mock = real orders on a mock account · real = live. An interactive call is demoted to dryrun whatever this says.

realArmed.label: Arm real money
realArmed.description: Even in real mode, orders stop at mock while this is off. The last lock.

killSwitch.label: Emergency stop
killSwitch.description: Halts all new orders. Trips by itself when the daily loss limit is reached.

realMaxNotionalKrw.label: Max notional per live order (KRW)
realMaxNotionalKrw.description: Cap on a single live order.

dailyLossLimitKrw.label: Daily loss limit (KRW)
dailyLossLimitKrw.description: Realised loss reaching this trips the emergency stop.

accountMaxNotionalKrw.label: Max position per account (KRW)
accountMaxNotionalKrw.description: Cap on what one account may hold.

maxOrdersPerCycle.label: Max orders per cycle
maxOrdersPerCycle.description: How many orders one decision pass may place.

confirmTimeoutSec.label: Acknowledgement timeout (s)
confirmTimeoutSec.description: How long to wait for the broker to accept an order.

unknownTimeoutSec.label: Unknown-order timeout (s)
unknownTimeoutSec.description: An order unconfirmed past this is marked unknown, and that strategy stops buying.

feeInCost.label: Fees in cost basis
feeInCost.description: Include the buy commission in the average price.

trades.label: Trades
trades.description: What runs where. One entry per trade — the same symbol in two accounts is two trades with separate ledgers. Rules do not go here; the model fills those in.

universe.label: Measurement symbols
universe.description: Symbols a rule is measured across, to show it is not an artefact of one. Separate from what is actually traded.

confirmUniverse.label: Confirmation symbols
confirmUniverse.description: Held out of the selection and used only for scoring. A rule that loses here is not adopted.

strategies.label: Hand-written strategies
strategies.description: Strategies a person declares. Leave empty to run only what the model adopted.

minClosedTrips.label: Revision trigger — completed trades
minClosedTrips.description: A rule is revised once this many entry-to-exit cycles have finished since it was last written. There is no closing bell in a 24-hour market, so this count is the clock. Setting it to 1 rewrites the rule after every trade, and a rewritten rule restarts the promotion ladder.
